result.title: Toward Structured Financial Foundation Models
result.summary: Foundation models promise reusable capabilities and step-change performance gains across tasks. In finance, large-scale pretraining of domain-specialized foundation models can advance both goals. However, prevailing architectures and objectives do not by themselves address the combined demands of financial systems: partial observability, interacting entities, asynchronous events, changing regimes, action-dependent outcomes, and rare states with disproportionate consequences. Moreover, independently developed specialists may learn incompatible representations, while multi-domain monolithic alternatives couple data access, model updates, and governance. We therefore propose a structured-data-first research agenda centered on modular, domain-specialized financial foundation models connected by a representation fabric for reuse and composition across domains and tasks. These models should maintain persistent financial state across aggregation levels and time horizons, capture its dynamics, and simulate action-conditioned futures, while remaining calibrated across regimes and for tail outcomes. They must also learn efficiently under data and access constraints and provide faithful, traceable explanations. We identify research challenges, directions, and capability-oriented evaluation criteria.

AI.brief_summary: 这是一篇金融领域的立场与议程论文，主张以结构化数据为先，构建模块化、领域专业化的金融基础模型，通过「表示织体」实现跨域复用与组合，并要求模型在多个聚合层级和时间尺度上维持持久金融状态、刻画其动态、模拟动作条件下的未来。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 latent visual reasoning 无直接关联，但其「部分可观测下维持持久多尺度状态并模拟动作条件未来」的议程，可能为 latent 推理状态的持续更新与展开提供概念参照；稀有尾部状态与制度切换下的校准评价，或可类比长链推理的鲁棒性与停止决策评价，属推测性线索，需人工核查。
